description: This file defines a persistent grain class 'SimplePersistentGrain' for use in an Orleans-based distributed application. It includes state management, lifecycle methods, and RPC-like interface methods for interacting with the grain's state, along with a serializable state class.

classes.name: SimplePersistentGrain_State
classes.description: Serializable state class for 'SimplePersistentGrain', containing two integer properties A and B used as persistent state variables.

classes.name: SimplePersistentGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing the 'ISimplePersistentGrain' interface, providing methods to set, get, and manipulate two integer state variables, and handle versioning and request context.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon grain activation; initializes version and logs activation.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the value of state property A.

methods.name: SetA (overload)
methods.description: Sets the value of A and optionally deactivates the grain.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the value of state property B.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of A by 1.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of A and B or provided arguments.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Returns the current value of A.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version GUID of the grain.
